$comment: One recipe's judgment must never cloud another's. Each scope lists its judgment surface (files or folders, repo-root relative; folders are scanned recursively, skipping *.test.mjs, fixtures/ and .test-tmp/) and the names it must never reference. Enforced by lib/recipe-isolation.test.mjs. A banned name is allowed only on a prohibition line or under a prohibition heading (never read / do not read / must not / never in scope / not in scope), and in prose files only: code gets no exemption. To add a recipe, append one object to scopes (see newScopeExample). Never relax a ban to make the test pass.
prohibition: never read|do not read|must not|never in scope|not in scope

scopes.why: Card recipe: body and zone cue passes, card plan and build, the simple intro (115 picks from catalog.json by design), cue and zone rulebooks, TASTE-SIMPLE. Must not pick up the free-design intro's taste or authoring prompts. Must not see the animate recipe's taste, skills or folder.

allow.why: Names its sibling to keep the two apart ("neither file inherits the other") and credits the two rules it quotes verbatim. Pinned: a 7th mention fails.

scopes.why: Free-design intro (complex flow): idea pass 110, screenplay authoring 130, frame review 140, TASTE-INTRO and lib/intro-film. The card catalog is a template set and must not reach its context. DESIGN.md and logos/registry.json are the brand and stay required, so card-library/ itself is not banned. Must not see the animate recipe's taste, skills or folder.
Rule-table coupon variant: no LLM, no taste. It writes cues.json by design, but must not lean on any recipe's judgment files.

Recipe-agnostic core (lib/kit/ plus the three utils it imports): assembly from an edit plan. It must hold no recipe's judgment: no cue, zone, card, intro, concept, screenplay or coupon knowledge, and no recipe file read. Imports are gated separately by lib/kit/kit-imports.test.mjs.

Free-design animate recipe (animate-flow): moment planning 030, per-moment authoring 040, its taste file, its two skills and the design systems it draws in. It must never see card templates, the card catalog, cue or zone rules, either visuals-flow taste file, the intro authoring contracts or the template recipe's feedback. 040 stages brand logos only, which is why card-library/ itself is not banned.

manualOnlySkills.$comment: Whole-video and taste skills that must never auto-load (owner 2026-10-08): they would cloud a recipe. Run them by name only. A vendor update that drops the flag fails this gate.

newScopeExample.why: Copy this object into scopes once the recipe folder exists; a surface path that does not exist fails the test.
